name: Rotatable mirror
description: A mirror on a stand that bounces light beams and turns in steps with Interact. Its face points along the instance's facing at yaw 0 (south, towards a beam travelling north). Wire a beam source, one or more of these and a beam sensor for the classic light puzzle.

stepAngle.description: Degrees one turn rotates the mirror.

inputs.name: turn
inputs.description: Interact turns the mirror by one step; the beam re-aims at once.

outputs.name: mirror
outputs.description: The mirror entity: beams bounce off it; its rotation is its push.config angle.
